title: 1. Planning and Research
info: Once I’ve gathered all the necessary details, I begin planning. I research the latest trends in web design and development, ensuring that the website will be modern, responsive, and optimized for performance. I also consider the most appropriate technology stack based on the project requirements.

title: 2. Testing and Debugging
info: Once the website is developed, I conduct rigorous testing. I test the site on different devices and browsers to ensure cross-browser compatibility. I also fix any bugs that may arise during testing and ensure the site is fully responsive.

title: 3. Client Review and Feedback
info: OnI then present the site to the client, asking for feedback to ensure the site meets their expectations. I make necessary revisions and adjustments based on the client's input to deliver a website that aligns with their vision.

title: 4. Launch and Support
info: After final approval, I launch the site and provide ongoing support to ensure smooth operation. I also offer training and documentation, empowering clients to manage their websites independently.
